name: mermaid-inline
description: Draws the Mermaid diagrams in Claude's replies: as pictures in Ghostty, cmux and kitty, and as Unicode box drawing in other terminals

mode.title: How to show diagrams
mode.description: auto (the default) draws pictures in terminals that show kitty-graphics pictures (Ghostty, cmux, kitty; not inside tmux) and Unicode box drawing elsewhere. on always draws pictures, text always draws box drawing, off leaves the code blocks as written.

teach_claude.title: Tell Claude it can draw diagrams
teach_claude.description: Adds a short section to the system prompt, only where diagrams are drawn as pictures, saying that mermaid code blocks are shown as diagrams and which kinds are supported.

theme.title: Diagram theme
theme.description: auto (the default) draws on your terminal's own background in its text color. Or one of zinc-light, zinc-dark, tokyo-night, tokyo-night-storm, tokyo-night-light, catppuccin-mocha, catppuccin-latte, nord, nord-light, dracula, github-light, github-dark, solarized-light, solarized-dark, one-dark, drawn on its own background.

colors.title: Color overrides
colors.description: Colors that win over the theme's, as key=#rrggbb pairs separated by spaces: bg (background), fg (text), line (edges), accent (arrow heads, highlights, chart series), muted (secondary text), surface (node fill), border (node outline). For example: accent=#d77757 line=#5c6370

font.title: Label font
font.description: auto (the default) uses Helvetica Neue on macOS and DejaVu Sans, Noto Sans or Liberation Sans on Linux; or the family name of a font installed on this machine. Hangul and other CJK text falls back to a system font that has it.

text_scale.title: Label size
text_scale.description: Diagram label size relative to your terminal's text. A diagram wider than the terminal is shrunk to fit.

node_path.title: Node.js executable
node_path.description: The node that runs the renderer, as a command on PATH or an absolute path.

font_metrics.title: Terminal font geometry
font_metrics.description: auto (the default) reads your terminal's font from its config (Ghostty, cmux, kitty) and works out the two numbers below the way the terminal does; they apply only when that fails. manual always uses them.

cell_aspect.title: Cell height over width
cell_aspect.description: Your terminal cell's height divided by its width, in pixels. 2.125 is Ghostty's default font, JetBrains Mono at 13pt; Fira Code at 12pt on a Retina display is 2.0. Diagrams look stretched when it is off.

line_height.title: Cell height in ems
line_height.description: The cell height in ems of your terminal font: 1.308 for JetBrains Mono at 13pt, 1.25 for Fira Code at 12pt. Sets how large labels are next to your text.
